# Bloomberg

> > Bloomberg provides financial data, news, analytics, and professional services through the Bloomberg Terminal and related platforms.

Bloomberg is a global leader in business and financial information, offering the Bloomberg Professional service (Bloomberg Terminal) alongside news, data analytics, and enterprise solutions. The platform serves financial professionals, corporations, and institutions worldwide.

## Key Topics

- Bloomberg Professional
- Bloomberg Terminal
- Bloomberg SID
- Account Management
- Billing Portal
- Invoice Access
- Payment Information
- Financial Data Services
- Professional Services
- Account Administration

## Account & Billing Management

- [Account Billing](https://service.bloomberg.com/portal/bobis/index): Bloomberg billing portal for invoice access and payment management
